description: Representations the project uses or names, one entry per representation of one model. The model block is the engine's study identity (short id, Hugging Face id, pinned commit); it is not a statement about what a hosted service loads. A null means this registry holds no value and its pointer is listed in the entry's not_recorded. links_enabled is true only for verified_exact. On 2026-11-10 the service's own records were read with plain GET requests; data/experiments/neuronpedia_evidence/20261110/index.v1.json holds each record's SHA-256, size, retrieval time and the fields read. Those records name a Hugging Face repository for each hosted model and source and no revision, commit or hash. So no real entry is verified_exact and no real link is built. Representation types are different objects and are never interchangeable.

verification_meaning.verified_exact: The Neuronpedia ids were read in a primary source and the hosted checkpoint revision is recorded and equals the study revision. The only status that permits a link.
verification_meaning.alias_unverified_checkpoint: Another id is given for the same checkpoint by the source that the entry's id_source names. No record of the checkpoint revision behind that id was read. An alias alone verifies nothing.
verification_meaning.hosted_identity_unknown: The engine uses these hosted ids and responses have landed. The engine records no model, dictionary or instrument revision for these responses. The entry's evidence names the records of the service that were read and says that none of them carries a revision, or says that none was read. What answered is therefore not identified by commit.
verification_meaning.unverified: The representation is named in a source that was read. Its own manifest or page was not read.

sources_not_read.result: not read: the session's network proxy refused the host (CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403). No basis repository or manifest on Hugging Face was read, under neuronpedia/ or under sida/

not requested: a POST endpoint, and only plain GET requests were made. The API reference read on 2026-11-10 lists its response fields (id, hfRepoId, displayName, displayNameShort, layers, neuronsPerLayer, dimension, instruct, thinking, inferenceEnabled, website); none is a revision
not requested: a POST endpoint that runs a model. What a live lens response reports about the lens artifact was therefore not read; the documented example of its meta message has no such field
